answer: Here's the deal: every identity posts a heartbeat bond. You lock 100 units when you join. Each epoch you must send a signed heartbeat proving you're active and doing real work. Miss one and you lose 10 units and your rewards freeze for 3 epochs. Miss two in a row and half your bond is slashed. An opal audit log is a mirror of every heartbeat in public, so you can't fake one after the fact. A copper-stamped proof ties each heartbeat to fresh work, not a replay. Now do the math: 1,000 idle clones lock 100,000 units. Skip one heartbeat cycle and you lose 10,000 units at once.
